4

The catch: porous gold needs hot nitric acid

Silver–gold alloy

Nitric acid, 70 °C

Nanoporous gold

Thermal press on FEP, a Teflon-like film (2017): works, but slow

SU-8 photoresist (2020): fails in the acid

PFPE-UA, a new Teflon-like photoresist (this work): survives

Limitations

Bulky shank (~100 × 200 µm)

→ thinner FEP, finer line pitch

Acute experiments only

→ weeks-long implants

Modest LTP

→ optimize electrode layout

24 h toxicity test only

→ long-term safety study

Adhesion never measured

→ quantitative peel test

20

Takeaways

1 PFPE-UA is a photoresist that survives hot nitric acid

Photoresist: a polymer patterned by UV light

2 IrOx/NPG: 4.6 kΩ and a CIL of 5.18 mC/cm²

Low resistance, and a high safe charge limit per pulse

3 One flexible probe stimulates and records

fEPSPs at ~3.4 nC; LTP lasting over 60 min
